newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 6.76 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 6.76 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 12.5 trillion lire 23-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 6.76 percent, compared with 6.82 percent at the previous repo tender on June 2, the Bank said.
The average rate was 6.82 percent against 6.89 percent at the last repurchase pact for 17.0 trillion lire and 28 days.
The pact covers purchases today and the securities are for resale on July 1. The Bank said it received 38 bids of which 34 were met in full and two in part.
